text:
jamie: thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A. quick thread to capture the short narrative we landed on and action items.

alex: quick narrative: start with the customer pain (surprising costs + ops load). then say: predictable economics, unified runtime, production controls. use perf as the verification, not the lead.

maria: suggested 15s external line: "Redwood makes LLM inference predictable: consistent latency, measurable unit cost, and a clear path from hosted to private deployments."

sam: for eng docs append: "GPU-optimized runtime with continuous batching, KV caching, and quant-friendly execution paths." optional for non-eng.

lee: standardized benchmarks to show: p50 chat latency, p99 tail, and $/1M tokens. ops-bot please pin the canonical bench link.

ops-bot: canonical bench: https://redwood.internal/bench/2025-q4 (internal access)

taylor: sales note: customers ask if we're "just another endpoint." reply: start Hosted, scale to Dedicated/Private for predictable throughput, lower unit cost, and compliance. emphasize the migration path.

jamie: competitor guidance: public collateral = categories (cloud-managed, hyperscalers, self-hosted). name vendors only in RFPs with data.

maria: I'll draft a short migration doc + FAQ for product docs (PR by Friday). includes when to choose Dedicated vs Private, measuring cost, and residency/KMS options.

sam: can we get a one-page cheat sheet for SEs/engs? even 300 words.

lee: I'll put together the engineer one-pager with decision heuristics and example configs. will include how fallbacks/multi-region preserve availability.

alex: i'll produce a canonical external paragraph after syncing with GTM Monday. no public unverified numbers.

taylor: i'll collect top sales objections and send to alex/maria.

jamie: action items recap: alex canonical paragraph; maria migration doc + FAQ PR; lee eng one-pager; taylor sales objections. i'll collate slide snippets once those land.

ops-bot: recording: https://meetings.redwood/ah-2025-11-07 (auto-post)

jamie: thanks everyone. drop follow-ups here or DM me.
